name: Palladian window
parts: central round-headed sash with radiating glazing bars and fanlight
two flanking rectangular sidelights with 3x4 muntins
Tuscan pilaster pairs with capitals and bases between lights
entablature over sidelights: architrave, frieze, dentil cornice
archivolt with keystone over the centre arch
limestone sill with drip groove and apron
glazing with putty-line stops and sash lock
style: architectural facade customizer, Georgian/Palladian: white painted pine casing, 12-pane sashes, limestone sill
summary: Georgian Palladian window, 1.8 x 2.6 m: arched centre sash and two sidelights, pilasters, impost entablatures, keystone, stone sill.
